description: Show the current account: id, state, attached email and whether it is verified, domains used, and which domains are available to claim under. When quotas are disabled the response omits 'quota' and says unlimited:true; 'max_subdomains' is the separate hard cap on how many names one account may hold at once (10 on the free plan, 100 on Pro). 'plan' is 'free' or 'pro'; when Pro is on sale a free account also gets an 'upgrade' hint (see upgrade_to_pro).
name: whoami
